🔥 UltraExplorer | C#
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide an intuitive and visually engaging way to navigate, manage, and understand complex file system hierarchies on Windows.
✨ Key Features: • Zoomable filesystem canvas • Native Windows file manager • Direct3D 11 rendering • Colour Tags for organization • Split view functionality
📖 Summary: UltraExplorer is a native Windows file manager that visualizes the file system as a zoomable canvas. It allows users to navigate and understand folder hierarchies intuitively by 'flying' into directories while maintaining awareness of the overall structure. The tool integrates familiar file management features with a novel zoomable user interface and quick preview capabilities.
